strings.59-ФЗ · условия прекращения: Law No. 59-ФЗ · conditions for ending correspondence
strings.59-ФЗ статья 11 часть статьи с условиями: 59-FZ Article 11 part of the article setting the conditions for ending correspondence
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенной: Author's training summary of the verified provision, not a website copy
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.Все три обращения направлены в один орга: All three appeals went to the same authority on the same issue; the third letter adds no new circumstances. However, the file contains only registration notices, not substantive answers. The employee prepares materials for consideration and does not independently decide to end correspondence.
Yes, I sent everything to this authority.
strings.Да: любые два сообщения равны двум ответ: Yes: any two messages equal two substantive responses.
strings.Да: отсутствие новых доводов заменяет вс: Yes: absence of new arguments replaces all other conditions.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Заменить проверку документов названием и: Replace document verification with the source's name.
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Исполнитель прислал ещё одно письмо: «Во: The case officer sent another letter: “The matter is being handled”, without answering the question raised.
The number of messages replaces analysis.
The follow-up clarification has been added to the case file.
Any two outgoing letters are sufficient.
strings.Мне дважды присылали письма о регистраци: They sent me two registration letters but never answered whether the passage would be restored. Today they proposed ending correspondence, saying they had already sent two responses.
strings.Найдите норму и подтвердите её применимо: Find the rule and confirm its applicability to the specific documents in the case.
strings.Найдите положение, которое подходит к ус: Find the provision that fits the established circumstances, not merely the topic of the submission.
strings.Найдите условие о характере ранее данных: Find the condition concerning the nature of earlier responses.
strings.Найдите часть статьи с условиями прекращ: Find the part of the article setting the conditions for ending correspondence and enter its number. Link the rule to the established circumstances.
strings.Не считать новое письмо поводом обнулить: Do not treat a new letter as a reason to erase earlier deadline violations.
strings.Нет, я повторяю вопрос, который пока ост: No, I am repeating the question that still has no answer.
strings.Нет: отсутствуют неоднократные ответы по: No: there have not been repeated substantive responses, even though two letters were sent.
strings.Нужны неоднократные письменные ответы по: Repeated written substantive responses are required; registration notices do not replace them.
strings.О присвоении номера и том, что обращение: They assigned a number and confirmed receipt. Nothing about the passage.
strings.О чём говорили предыдущие письма?: What did the earlier letters say?
strings.Объяснить заявителю дальнейший порядок: Explain the next steps to the applicant
strings.Одинаков ли орган-получатель?: Is the receiving authority the same?
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Отметить, что вопрос по существу не разр: Record that the substantive issue remains unresolved and continue monitoring proper consideration.
strings.Отсутствие нового довода не создаёт отсу: Absence of a new argument does not create the missing substantive responses.
strings.Отсутствие новых доводов не позволяет пр: Absence of new arguments does not permit ending correspondence when there have only been registration messages.
strings.Письменное обращение зарегистрировано. П: The written submission has been registered. The scenario specifies that no extension was applied. Find the last permissible day for a reply.
strings.Письмо 1: «Обращению присвоен номер». Пи: Letter 1: “Your appeal has been assigned a number.” Letter 2: “Materials received.” Neither answers the question about the passage or contains a reasoned decision.
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение вопроса по суще: Prepare substantive consideration of the issue
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение неразрешённого: Prepare consideration of the unresolved issue by an authorised employee.
strings.Подтверждает ли счётчик писем условия пр: Does the letter counter establish the conditions for ending correspondence?
strings.Помощник: «Автоматический счётчик исходя: Assistant: “The automatic outgoing counter proves substantive consideration.”
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Прекратить переписку из-за двух исходящи: End correspondence because two notices were sent.
strings.Прекратить переписку по одному счётчику: End correspondence based solely on a counter
strings.Прекращение переписки по вопросу допуска: An authorised person may end correspondence on an issue when all prescribed conditions are met. Check substantive replies, absence of new matters and the same recipient; notify the decision.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Применимость к конкретной истории устана: Applicability to a particular story depends on its circumstances. A document title alone does not justify the selected action.
strings.Применить правило независимо от обстояте: Apply the rule regardless of the circumstances.
strings.Принятое действие не обеспечивает необхо: The selected action does not ensure the required verification of the result.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Проверить регистрацию текущего обращения: Check registration of the current appeal
strings.Проверяется содержание прошлых ответов,: Check the contents of earlier responses, not just a numerical counter.
strings.Промежуточное сообщение не становится ит: An interim message does not become a final outcome merely because of its sequence number.
strings.Просьба рассмотреть восстановление прохо: A request to consider restoring the passage. The subject and authority are unchanged; there are no new arguments.
strings.Регистрационные сообщения не разрешают п: Registration messages do not resolve the question raised.
The system shows two outgoing letters. Their contents have not been classified.
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Совпадение органа есть, но недостаточно: The authority is the same, but that alone is insufficient.
strings.Содержание прежних ответов не проверяетс: The contents of earlier responses need not be checked.
strings.Сопоставить поставленный вопрос и тексты: Compare the issue raised with the texts of earlier letters
strings.Сопоставьте выбранный маршрут, полномочи: Compare the selected referral route, powers and plan. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Сохранить контроль действительного ответ: Keep monitoring the actual response and preserve the appeal history
strings.Сохранён самостоятельный ранее поставлен: This is a retained standalone scenario supplied earlier, not a new variant in this release.
strings.Сравните документы: кто их составил, к к: Compare the documents: who prepared them, and which site and issue they concern. Mark only the materials needed for the selected conclusion.
strings.Теперь считать три исходящих достаточным: Now treat three outgoing letters as a sufficient response.
strings.Удалить старые письма, чтобы убрать проб: Delete the old letters to remove the record-keeping problem.
Delete the third letter from the history.
strings.Уточните обстоятельства, прежде чем поль: Clarify the circumstances before using the solution to a similar case.
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
